name: DHL Supply Chain - DC - Dallas/Irving TX

fieldNotes.location: Resolved to 5320 W Airport Freeway, Irving TX 75062 — the $57.5M, 220,000 sq ft DHL distribution center opened 2024 (relocated from Grand Prairie), the marquee DHL distribution facility in Irving. The roster gave no address ('contract-logistics DC building street addresses not publicly enumerated'); web research (DHL press release, Supply Chain Dive, WFAA, Commercial Real Estate Direct) identified this as the DHL DC in Irving and Google Geocoding API returned ROOFTOP precision (32.83530, -97.03138). Street View confirmed the DHL red/yellow brand livery on the building. NOTE: this is operated by the DHL eCommerce division (parcel sortation) rather than the DHL Supply Chain contract-logistics division — but it is the verifiable DHL DC matching the roster's 'Dallas/Irving' entry; the roster compiler could not pin a separate DHL Supply Chain street address. An alternative DHL Supply Chain / Discount Tire dedicated warehouse exists at 10101 Bonnie View Rd, but that is in Dallas proper, not Irving.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The SE truck court is enclosed by a continuous perimeter fence (regularly-spaced posts clearly visible in z21 satellite along the dock-apron edge). The gate hardware at the entrance driveway could not be seen directly because a mature tree buffer screens the property from the public loop road — flagged uncertain. A 2024 purpose-built dedicated DHL DC with a fenced court is consistent with a controlled truck gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth visible; modern parcel-sortation DCs use kiosk / remote check-in.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gated court with no guard shack implies kiosk / call-box / app check-in.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock aprons run along TWO opposite faces (NW toward Airport Freeway, SE toward the truck court) — consistent with the facility's documented four-inbound / four-outbound induction-line design, supporting separate shipping and receiving dock banks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Docks on both long faces of the ~280 m building; combined banded estimate 50+. Exact count not resolvable from overexposed white-roof satellite — flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Only a handful of trailers parked; the facility is a new active parcel DC with dock-position trailers rather than a dedicated drop lot.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Single truck-court driveway; lane detail obscured by the tree buffer — counts set to 1/1 as best estimate, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property; road-served, directly off SH-183 Airport Freeway.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Central Irving within the dense DFW metro along SH-183; Urban.

citations.claim: The only Tier-1 addressed DHL DFW facility (5320 W Airport Freeway, Irving TX, 220k SF) is operated by DHL eCommerce (parcel division), NOT DHL Supply Chain.

verification.rationale: The only exact Tier-1 DFW address belongs to DHL eCommerce, a different division; for DHL Supply Chain specifically only aggregator listings appear with no Tier-1 exact-address source. No positive found.
